import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" INK = "#263238" SLATE = "#657786" LIGHT = "#E5EAE8"
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "text.usetex": False, "text.color": INK, "axes.labelcolor": INK, "axes.edgecolor": SLATE, "xtick.color": SLATE, "ytick.color": SLATE, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "lines.linewidth": 1.8, "svg.fonttype": "none", })
u0 = np.array([1.0, 1.0]) u1 = np.array([1.0, -1.0]) x = np.array([5.0, 1.0]) p0 = np.dot(x, u0) / np.dot(u0, u0) * u0 p1 = np.dot(x, u1) / np.dot(u1, u1) * u1 assert np.dot(u0, u1) == 0 assert np.allclose(p0 + p1, x)
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.4, 4.2), facecolor="white")
fig.text(0.045, 0.935, "a", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold") fig.text(0.075, 0.935, "Cancellation across samples", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold") fig.text(0.515, 0.935, "b", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold") fig.text(0.545, 0.935, "Orthogonality in sample space", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
signal_axes = [ fig.add_axes([0.085, 0.565, 0.145, 0.245]), fig.add_axes([0.310, 0.565, 0.145, 0.245]), ] # Use only basic, portable mathtext syntax for vector transposes. for ax, values, color, title in zip( signal_axes, [u0, u1], [BLUE, TEAL], [r"$u_0=[1,\,1]^T$", r"$u_1=[1,\,-1]^T$"], ): ax.axhline(0, color=SLATE, linewidth=0.85, zorder=0) ax.vlines([0, 1], 0, values, color=color, linewidth=2.5) ax.scatter([0, 1], values, s=40, color=color, zorder=3) ax.set_xlim(-0.35, 1.35) ax.set_ylim(-1.35, 1.4) ax.set_xticks([0, 1]) ax.set_yticks([-1, 0, 1]) ax.set_yticklabels(["−1", "0", "+1"]) ax.set_xlabel(r"Sample index $n$", fontsize=9, labelpad=4) ax.set_title(title, color=color, fontsize=11, pad=10) ax.spines["bottom"].set_visible(False) ax.spines["left"].set_color(LIGHT) ax.tick_params(length=2.5, width=0.8, labelsize=9) signal_axes[0].set_ylabel("Amplitude", fontsize=9, labelpad=5)
fig.text(0.075, 0.422, "Element-wise multiplication", fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold") fig.text(0.085, 0.350, r"$n=0:$", color=SLATE, fontsize=11) fig.text(0.175, 0.350, r"$(+1)\times(+1)=+1$", fontsize=12) fig.text(0.085, 0.280, r"$n=1:$", color=SLATE, fontsize=11) fig.text(0.175, 0.280, r"$(+1)\times(-1)=-1$", fontsize=12) fig.text( 0.075, 0.168, r"$\langle u_0,u_1\rangle=(+1)+(-1)=0$", fontsize=14, color=INK, ) fig.text(0.075, 0.090, "Equal and opposite contributions cancel.", fontsize=9.5, color=SLATE)
ax = fig.add_axes([0.545, 0.155, 0.415, 0.690]) ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box") ax.set_xlim(-0.55, 5.85) ax.set_ylim(-2.65, 3.75)
# Span guides distinguish the basis directions from their basis arrows. t0 = np.array([-0.45, 3.55]) t1 = np.array([-0.45, 2.50]) ax.plot(t0, t0, color=BLUE, alpha=0.22, lw=1.2, zorder=0) ax.plot(t1, -t1, color=TEAL, alpha=0.22, lw=1.2, zorder=0)
for spine in ax.spines.values(): spine.set_visible(False) ax.annotate( "", xy=(5.7, 0), xytext=(-0.48, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=SLATE, lw=0.9, mutation_scale=9), zorder=1, ) ax.annotate( "", xy=(0, 3.62), xytext=(0, -2.5), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=SLATE, lw=0.9, mutation_scale=9), zorder=1, ) ax.set_xticks([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) ax.set_yticks([-2, -1, 1, 2, 3]) ax.spines["bottom"].set_position(("data", 0)) ax.spines["left"].set_position(("data", 0)) ax.xaxis.set_ticks_position("bottom") ax.yaxis.set_ticks_position("left") ax.tick_params(length=3, width=0.7, pad=3, labelsize=8) ax.text(5.65, -0.40, r"$x[0]$", fontsize=10, ha="center") ax.text(-0.13, 3.68, r"$x[1]$", fontsize=10, ha="right", va="bottom")
# Orthogonal projections onto the two basis spans. for foot, color in [(p0, BLUE), (p1, TEAL)]: ax.plot( [x[0], foot[0]], [x[1], foot[1]], color=color, lw=1.4, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)), alpha=0.8, zorder=2, ) ax.scatter( *foot, s=33, facecolor="white", edgecolor=color, linewidth=1.5, zorder=4, )
def vector_arrow(endpoint, color, width, zorder): ax.annotate( "", xy=endpoint, xytext=(0, 0), arrowprops=dict( arrowstyle="-|>", color=color, lw=width, mutation_scale=13, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, ), zorder=zorder, )
vector_arrow(u0, BLUE, 2.3, 5) vector_arrow(u1, TEAL, 2.3, 5) vector_arrow(x, INK, 2.2, 4)
# Right-angle square aligned with the two orthogonal basis directions. a = 0.28 * u0 / np.linalg.norm(u0) b = 0.28 * u1 / np.linalg.norm(u1) square = np.vstack([a, a + b, b]) ax.plot(square[:, 0], square[:, 1], color=INK, lw=1.1, zorder=6)
ax.text(0.75, 1.25, r"$u_0$", color=BLUE, fontsize=11, ha="center") ax.text(0.87, -1.40, r"$u_1$", color=TEAL, fontsize=11, ha="center") ax.text( 3.08, 3.04, r"$3u_0=[3,\,3]^T$", color=BLUE, fontsize=10, va="bottom", ha="left", ) ax.text( 2.08, -2.15, r"$2u_1=[2,\,-2]^T$", color=TEAL, fontsize=10, va="top", ha="left", ) ax.text( 5.03, 1.23, r"$x=[5,\,1]^T$", color=INK, fontsize=10, ha="right", va="bottom", ) fig.text(0.735, 0.080, r"$x=3u_0+2u_1$", fontsize=12, ha="center") fig.text( 0.735, 0.032, "Dashed lines: orthogonal projections", fontsize=8.5, color=SLATE, ha="center", )
